label: WaterTAP Two-Stage LSRRO
request: Build and solve a two-stage LSRRO train for 70 kg/m3 NaCl feed at 1e-3 m3/s. Use a standard first RO stage, a low-salt-rejection second stage, recycle boosted stage-2 permeate to the first-stage mixer, and recover pressure from interstage retentate and final brine. Report water recovery, product salinity, membrane area, SEC, LCOW, and recovered pump work.
